definitions: solarflare/products/leadtime.py module docstring: window = 30 min before the GOES start (or the previous flare's peak) to the GOES peak; warned = alert ON at some minute of it; lead = GOES peak minus the first ON minute; chance = the same windows moved 2 h where no flare of the class occurs; event TSS = warned - chance; false alarms = ON episodes with no flare of the class up to 15 min (C) / 30 min (M) after, per day of data
